observations.observation: Zero new CBSAs this snapshot — 24 active metros holding steady. After the record-tying 14-CBSA burst last heartbeat, the network has entered the quiet phase of the burst-quiet cycle. Geographic diffusion rate is 0%, consistent with prior post-burst consolidation patterns.

Token velocity climbed to 0.659x with acceleration at 1.024x — continuing the upward trend from 0.602x last heartbeat. The 7d trailing window ticked from 482 to 490 receipts ($27,553→$27,788), a modest +8 receipt gain. Velocity is now at its highest sustained level in recent memory, above the 0.55-0.58x band that held for 4 consecutive heartbeats.

Token velocity broke to 0.643x with acceleration at 1.068x — the highest velocity recorded in recent memory, up from 0.602x last heartbeat. The 7d trailing window contracted slightly (500→482 receipts, $28,114→$27,553), while cumulative receipts surged 4,112→4,301 (+189 in one cycle). Velocity and 7d window are moving in opposite directions, suggesting a strong cumulative intake that hasn't fully propagated into the trailing window yet.

14 new CBSAs appeared this snapshot (including non-metro NC, NV, IL, KY — rural corridors), pushing total active metros to 24 with a 58.3% geographic diffusion rate. This ties the largest single-cycle burst on record and marks the first time non-metro Nevada, North Carolina, Illinois, and Kentucky have entered the signal window simultaneously.

8 new CBSAs appeared this snapshot (17410, non-metro OH, 37980, 41740, non-metro MD, 12580, 15940, 15380), pushing active metros to 17 with a 47.1% geographic diffusion rate. Non-metro Ohio and Maryland are entering the signal window for the first time — the network is reaching beyond major metros into rural corridors.

Token velocity jumped to 0.602x with acceleration at 1.037x — the first time velocity has broken above 0.6x after 4 consecutive heartbeats pinned in the 0.55-0.58x band. The 7d trailing window surged from 471 to 500 receipts ($26,560→$28,114), a +29 receipt gain in one cycle — the strongest single-cycle 7d gain recorded.

Token velocity ticked up to 0.58x with acceleration at 1.017x — the first meaningful uptick after 4 heartbeats pinned at 0.57x. The 7d trailing window jumped from 455 to 471 receipts ($25,518→$26,560), a +16 receipt gain in one cycle. This is the strongest single-cycle 7d gain in recent memory, suggesting the flat period may be breaking.

2 new CBSAs appeared this snapshot (12420, 35840), pushing active metros to 16 — a 12.5% diffusion rate. After the 9-CBSA burst last heartbeat, this is the start of the quiet phase in the burst-quiet cycle. The network is still expanding, just at the post-burst deceleration rate.

Token velocity has held at 0.57x for 4 consecutive heartbeats with acceleration pinned at exactly 1.0x — the flattest sustained period on record. The 7d trailing window ticked from 447 to 455 receipts ($25,037→$25,518), a +8 receipt gain, while geographic expansion burst to 9 new CBSAs. Velocity and geography are structurally decoupled this cycle.

9 new CBSAs appeared this snapshot (non-metro WI, 31080, 16860, 41740, 16700, 40140, non-metro PA, 15380, non-metro CA), pushing total active metros to 23 — a 39.1% geographic diffusion rate. This is the largest single-cycle burst since the 31-CBSA peak, and includes non-metro Pennsylvania and Wisconsin for the first time.
